title: FutureLift: Lifting Trajectory Proposals into Bidirectional Future Graphs for Motion Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.22215v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate motion prediction is critical for safe autonomous driving, yet even strong forecasters leave residual errors in their multimodal proposals. Existing refiners compress complete proposals or update their segments sequentially, preventing the full proposed future from serving as explicit relational context for correction. We introduce FutureLift, a backbone-agnostic refiner that represents each multimodal proposal as a heterogeneous future graph, with spatially grounded temporal nodes connected to agent histories, map elements, alternative modes, and, for joint prediction, other agents future trajectories. Bidirectional temporal edges allow later evidence to revise earlier segments in a single pass, and the updated nodes predict residual coordinate and confidence corrections. Requiring only proposals, scores, and scene context, FutureLift provides a common refinement interface for structurally different forecasting backbones. On

translated_title: FutureLift：将轨迹提议提升为双向未来图以用于运动预测
translated_abstract: 准确的运动预测对于安全的自动驾驶至关重要，然而即使是强大的预测器也会在其多模态提议中留下残差误差。现有的改进器要么压缩完整的提议，要么按顺序更新其片段，这使得完整的提议未来无法作为显式的关联上下文用于修正。我们提出了FutureLift，一种与主干网络无关的改进器，它将每个多模态提议表示为一个异构未来图，其中具有空间锚定的时间节点，这些节点连接到智能体历史、地图元素、替代模态，以及在联合预测场景下连接到其他智能体的未来轨迹。双向时间边允许后续证据在单次遍历中修正较早的片段，更新后的节点则预测残差坐标和置信度修正。FutureLift仅需要提议、分数和场景上下文作为输入，为结构不同的预测主干网络提供了一个通用的改进接口。在...
tldr: FutureLift提出了一种与主干网络无关的轨迹提议改进方法，将多模态提议表示为带有双向时间边的异构未来图，使后续证据能够在单次遍历中修正较早的片段，从而提升自动驾驶运动预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: FutureLift is a backbone-agnostic refiner that represents multimodal trajectory proposals as heterogeneous future graphs with bidirectional temporal edges, enabling later evidence to revise earlier segments in a single pass for improved autonomous driving motion forecasting.
